'''Jeff Brentson''' is a Star Wars CCG player who played at [[August 2000 Terryville tournament]] on 19 August 2000 with [[You Can Either Profit By This... / Or Be Destroyed|Profit]], according to Andrew Ledwith's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d1151">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-08-21-terryville-ct-8-19-00d1151/ terryville-ct-8-19-00], DeckTech (Andrew "Gadget" Ledwith, 21 August 2000). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2000-08-21-terryville-ct-8-19-00d1151/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
